films.desc_en: A fast-paced, vertical social media teaser showcasing a premium winter getaway in the snowy mountains.
films.music: Upbeat electronic winter pop, punchy bass, 120 bpm
vo_mk: Откриј го твоето совршено зимско бегство денес.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. A steaming ceramic mug of hot chocolate rests on a rustic wooden balcony railing. The background features the blurred, snow-covered pine trees and majestic mountain peaks of Mavrovo under a bright, crisp blue sky. Center focus, bright natural sunlight, premium cinematic lighting, photorealistic, warm color palette against cool snow.
shots.motion: Thick steam gently rises from the mug and drifts to the right. Slow, smooth camera push-in towards the mug.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. A pair of premium, unmarked wooden skis leaning against the dark timber wall of a luxury boutique cabin. Warm, glowing light spills from a frosted glass window next to the door. Crisp winter afternoon light, sharp focus on the skis, rich textures of wood and snow, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Snowflakes fall gently in the foreground. The camera slowly tilts up from the base of the skis to the tips.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. A modern, glass-enclosed fireplace burning brightly in the center of a dimly lit, luxurious wooden room. Soft faux-fur blankets rest on a leather chair in the blurred foreground. Rich amber and orange glowing light, deep shadows, intimate and warm color palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The bright orange flames flicker and dance inside the glass enclosure. Very slow camera pan to the right.

films.desc_en: A slow, emotional cinematic journey capturing the peaceful essence of a summer morning on a tranquil lake.
films.music: Gentle acoustic guitar, soft ambient strings, slow 65 bpm

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9 composition. A serene sunrise over the glassy, calm waters of Lake Ohrid. Silhouettes of distant mountains fade into a soft morning mist. The sky is painted in delicate pastel hues of pink, lavender, and gold. Soft, diffused morning light, wide-angle lens, photorealistic, cinematic landscape.
shots.motion: The water ripples very gently reflecting the pastel sky. Slow, sweeping camera pan from left to right.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9 composition. A beautifully weathered, empty wooden rowboat gently resting in crystal clear, shallow turquoise water near a wooden pier. Smooth pebbles are visible beneath the surface. Warm golden hour light highlights the textures of the wood. Close-up, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, tranquil mood.
shots.motion: The boat bobs almost imperceptibly on the gentle tiny waves. Slow camera glide moving forward over the water.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9 composition. A white linen-covered table set for breakfast on a stone terrace overlooking the lake. Fresh figs, a silver coffee pot, and crystal glasses catch the morning light. No people. Vibrant summer greens and deep lake blues, crisp bright lighting, macro lens detail, photorealistic luxury.
shots.motion: A gentle morning breeze rustles the edge of the white linen tablecloth. Slow camera track to the left.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9 composition. Looking from inside a softly lit, minimalist boutique hotel room out towards a balcony with a lake view. Sheer white linen curtains frame the open glass doors. Soft, airy natural light pouring into the room, creating long elegant shadows. Neutral and bright color palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The sheer white curtains billow softly in the invisible summer breeze. The camera remains completely static.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9 composition. A single, elegant white swan floating on the dark, reflective blue surface of the lake. The background is a soft blur of dark green weeping willow branches hanging gently over the calm water. Perfect symmetry, high contrast, cinematic telephoto lens, peaceful and majestic, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The swan glides smoothly and slowly forward through the frame. Slow camera track following the swan's movement.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9 composition. The mouth of a river gently flowing into a vast lake at twilight. Warm glowing lanterns illuminate a beautiful wooden pathway along the water's edge. Deep twilight blues mixed with warm amber artificial lights. Wide cinematic shot, atmospheric and romantic, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The surface of the river flows steadily towards the calm lake. Slow, majestic camera crane shot moving slowly upward.

films.desc_en: A clear, step-by-step visual explainer of the premium guest experience at a traditional mountain guesthouse.
films.music: Warm acoustic folk, rhythmic percussion, relaxed 90 bpm
vo_mk: Сместувањето започнува со топло добредојде во нашите традиционални соби.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9 composition. A beautifully restored traditional Macedonian stone guesthouse with wooden balconies, surrounded by lush green mountain forests. A cobblestone path leads to the heavy wooden entrance door. Bright midday sun, clear blue sky, architectural photography style, natural greens and earth tones, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Shadows from the surrounding trees drift slowly across the stone facade. Slow camera push-in towards the front door.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9 composition. A luxurious yet rustic bedroom interior featuring a large bed with crisp, thick white duvets and intricately woven traditional Macedonian wool blankets. Sunbeams cross the wooden floor. Warm, inviting lighting, wide-angle interior lens, rich textures of wool and wood, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Dust motes dance in the shaft of sunlight hitting the bed. Slow, steady camera pan across the room.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9 composition. A modern outdoor wooden hot tub steaming quietly in a peaceful mountain forest clearing. The tub is surrounded by smooth river stones and tall green ferns. Dappled sunlight filters through the dense forest canopy, creating a serene, secluded atmosphere. Natural earthy color palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Steam gently rises and swirls from the surface of the hot water. The camera slowly tracks horizontally to the right.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9 composition. A rustic wooden kitchen table covered with fresh, vibrant local produce: bright red tomatoes, green peppers, artisanal cheese, and a loaf of crusty baked bread. Soft, diffused window light illuminates the food like a classic still-life painting. Macro lens, rich colors, photorealistic.
shots.motion: A subtle wisp of steam rises from the freshly baked crusty bread. Very slow camera push-in on the cheese and bread.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9 composition. A crystal wine glass sitting on a wooden barrel. A stream of rich, dark ruby-red wine is frozen mid-pour into the glass from an unseen bottle above. Warm, moody cellar lighting highlights the deep crimson tones of the liquid. High contrast, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The dark red wine flows smoothly and continuously into the crystal glass. The camera remains completely static to emphasize the liquid motion.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9 composition. An elegant outdoor stone fire pit glowing with bright orange embers and gentle flames under a starry night sky. Empty wooden lounge chairs surround the fire. The cool blue of the night contrasts beautifully with the warm orange firelight. Cinematic night photography, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The flames flicker and dance brightly over the glowing wooden logs. Slow camera orbit moving circularly around the fire pit.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9 composition. A breathtaking view from a high mountain balcony, looking down over a lush green valley covered in a low, soft morning fog. A simple wooden chair sits empty in the foreground. Soft, diffused morning light, vast depth of field, epic landscape, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The thick white morning fog rolls and shifts slowly through the valley below. Slow camera tilt up towards the sky.

films.desc_en: A serene 30-second commercial showcasing the luxurious and relaxing experience at a premium boutique hotel on Lake Ohrid.
films.music: Relaxing, ambient acoustic guitar with soft cinematic strings, 75 bpm.
vo_mk: Секој момент е создаден за тебе.

shots.kf: A 35-year-old woman with shoulder-length wavy brunette hair, wearing a flowing white linen dress, stands on a traditional stone terrace in the shade, closing her eyes. Soft diffused morning light illuminates the earthy tones of the architecture. Shot with a 50mm lens, medium portrait framing. Photorealistic, premium cinematic look.
shots.motion: The woman takes a deep breath, her chest rising visibly, while the camera executes a very slow push-in to emphasize her relaxation.

shots.kf: A 35-year-old woman with shoulder-length wavy brunette hair, wearing a flowing white linen dress, walking on a wooden dock over crystal-clear blue lake water. Bright summer sunlight, wide shot, 24mm lens. Photorealistic, vibrant cyan and warm wood colors.
shots.motion: The woman walks slowly forward along the wooden dock, gentle ripples form on the lake water, with a slow tracking camera movement.

shots.kf: Close-up of a premium wooden table. A sleek silver tray with fresh green figs and white cheese is placed on the table. In the blurred background, sparkling blue lake water. Warm afternoon sunlight, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. Photorealistic.
shots.motion: The silver tray gently settles onto the wooden table, while the camera performs a very slow and smooth pan to the right.

shots.kf: A 35-year-old woman with shoulder-length wavy brunette hair, wearing a flowing white linen dress, reclining on a luxurious white sunbed. She is smiling softly with her eyes closed, basking in the sun. Golden hour lighting, 50mm lens. Photorealistic, warm golden tones.
shots.motion: The woman tilts her head slightly back as a gentle breeze moves her hair, while the camera remains completely static.

shots.kf: Majestic wide shot of a beautiful stone boutique hotel with an infinity pool that seamlessly blends with the vast lake. Sunset sky with orange and purple hues. 16mm lens, sweeping landscape composition. Photorealistic, premium architectural photography.
shots.motion: Gentle ripples move across the surface of the infinity pool as the camera executes a very slow, majestic pull-back to reveal the landscape.

films.desc_en: A cozy 30-second commercial highlighting the warmth and comfort of a traditional mountain guesthouse retreat during the winter season.
films.music: Warm, cozy acoustic folk with gentle piano and cello, 80 bpm.

shots.kf: A 40-year-old man with a short beard, wearing a thick dark green wool sweater, standing by a heavy wooden door. Snowflakes are resting on his shoulders. Cold blue winter lighting, 50mm lens, medium close-up. Photorealistic, cinematic winter palette.
shots.motion: The man gently brushes snowflakes off his thick wool shoulder with his hand, accompanied by a slow push-in camera movement.

shots.kf: A 40-year-old man with a short beard, wearing a thick dark green wool sweater, looking through a large window covered in frost. Outside, dense pine trees covered in deep snow. Soft diffused indoor lighting, 35mm lens, over-the-shoulder shot. Photorealistic.
shots.motion: The man turns his head slightly to look out, snow falls gently outside the frosted window, with a slow camera pan to the left.

shots.kf: Close-up of a rustic stone fireplace. Thick wooden logs are burning with bright orange and yellow flames. Glowing embers. Warm, dynamic firelight, 85mm macro lens, shallow depth of field. Photorealistic, rich contrast.
shots.motion: Bright orange flames flicker and dance naturally around the wooden logs, glowing embers pulse with heat, while the camera remains completely static.

shots.kf: A 40-year-old man with a short beard, wearing a thick dark green wool sweater, sitting deep in a rich brown leather armchair. He is holding a steaming ceramic mug, smiling with deep relaxation. Warm firelight illumination, 50mm lens. Photorealistic, cozy amber tones.
shots.motion: Thick steam rises steadily from the ceramic mug as the man takes a slow, relaxed breath, with a gentle camera push-in.

shots.kf: Wide exterior shot of a luxurious wooden mountain chalet at twilight. Thick snow on the roof and ground, tall snow-covered pine trees. Warm golden light glowing strongly from the windows. Deep blue dusk sky. 24mm lens. Photorealistic, magical winter atmosphere.
shots.motion: Snowflakes fall softly and continuously through the twilight air as the camera executes a very slow drone-like pull-back from the glowing chalet.
